coverage.main: Read complete cached arXiv v1, all thirteen pages including appendix. Visually checked main PDF pp. 5-8 covering setup, all main result tables and the kernel-size figure.
coverage.supplement: Retrieved and read all three pages of the CVF supplement; visually checked all three pages. It covers Tables 6-12 also present in the arXiv appendix, so these are not counted twice.
coverage.excluded_results: Figures 1,2,5 illustrate examples or attention, not quantitative transfer rates. Figure 3 is a loss-surface diagnostic. Starred diagonals in supplementary Tables 6-8 are white-box evidence only. Discussion of C&W/BIM is methodological background: Section 4.1 explicitly omits them from the empirical comparison.

f1.locator: Section 4.1; main Tables 1-5; appendix/CVF supplement Tables 6-12
f1.evidence: Model names, attacked rates and white-box diagonals are given, but a complete set of separate clean accuracies on the evaluation population was not located. Loss surfaces in Figure 3 are not clean classification accuracies. Silence does not support no.

f2.evidence: The competition dataset size is explicit but not a rule excluding target-clean-incorrect images. No affirmative or negative denominator filtering statement established across the five groups.

f3.evidence: Target misclassification defines success, but the reviewed material does not explicitly specify source-failure retention or exclusion in the transfer denominator. The generator saving every input is not by itself evidence of the published evaluator's denominator.

f4.evidence: A one-decimal percentage on exactly 1,000 unaveraged evaluations can identify a unique count, so percentages are not automatically no. Here filtered denominators, randomized-defense aggregation and exact Figure 4 values are not completely established. No per-example clean/source/target outcome release was located in the inspected artifact.

f5.locator: Section 3 Eq. 1, Section 4.1; appendix p. 11 / CVF supplement p. 1
f5.evidence: Main experiments specify L-infinity epsilon=16 with [0,255] pixels. The normal-target supplement explicitly carries over attack settings. L2 Tables 9-12 explicitly use epsilon=10*sqrt(d), with d defined as input dimension: a dimension-normalized numerical radius, not merely a norm name. Record the formula as stated; runtime input dimensions and preprocessing still need verification before recomputation.

f6.evidence: Attack generation code, model definitions, dataset material and responsive source-checkpoint links are available. A validated original defense evaluation path and matching target checkpoints/outcomes were not established. Code availability and HTTP success do not by themselves establish executable recomputation of conditioning quantities.

bounds_checks.reason: No paired target clean accuracy on the actual rate population was established, and source-success denominator policy remains unresolved. Do not borrow accuracy from other papers using similarly named models or infer clean accuracy from white-box attack diagonals. No new numerical bounds extracted.

limitations: Complete means documented non-blind evidence review; artifact sufficiency, original-runtime fidelity and independent coding remain unresolved.
The cached arXiv appendix and separately retrieved CVF supplement are overlapping evidence, not independent experiments or independent extractions.
No claim is made that a release is absent or that the paper is wrong. No historical coding or numerical recomputation results were overwritten.
